replay.description: True when this response replays an already-recorded outcome.
replay.title: Replay

exclude_repos.description: Repo names whose shared local checkout is busy on this worker.
exclude_repos.title: Exclude Repos

request_id.description: Retry with the same id after a lost response.
request_id.title: Request Id

EngineeringResult.description: Compact pointer-style result. Large logs/artifacts stay outside the control plane.

source.description: How the result was obtained, e.g. 'spine-result' or 'delivery-md'.
source.title: Source

EngineeringResult.title: EngineeringResult

reason.description: For stale_attempt: why the caller is not the owner.
reason.title: Reason

goal.description: Requirement text, delivered verbatim into the repository.
goal.title: Goal

key.description: Idempotency key. Same key => same job (e.g. 'inbox:<id>').
key.title: Key

name.description: Human label; used in tmux session and requirement file names.
name.title: Name

active_attempts.description: Attempts the control plane believes this worker currently owns.
active_attempts.title: Active Attempts

Repository.description: Global repository identity. Never a worker-local path.

name.description: Logical name; workers map it to a local checkout via [repos].
name.title: Name

owner.description: Account/org that owns the repo; required for target=new.
owner.title: Owner

ref.description: Branch/ref to check out (clone path only).
ref.title: Ref

url.description: Clone URL. When set, any worker with git can serve the job.
url.title: Url

Repository.title: Repository

capabilities.description: Worker capabilities that must be true.
capabilities.title: Capabilities

repos.description: Repository names this worker maps to local checkouts.
repos.title: Repos

info.description: Job intake, worker registration, atomic claim, lease + epoch fencing, results and events. Every attempt mutation carries (attempt_id, worker_id, epoch); the server rejects any caller that is not the job's current, unexpired owner with 409 stale_attempt.
info.title: Ganglion Control Plane

get.description: Server-side policy workers should follow (lease TTL, heartbeat interval, ...).

schema.title: Response List Jobs V1 Jobs Get

post.description: Atomically claim the oldest eligible job. `job` is null when nothing is eligible.

get.description: Look up by job id, idempotency key, or name (most recent). Includes the full attempt history.
Counters and gauges derived from the database (restart-safe). ?format=prometheus for text.
